changes.title: Candles terrace
items: The knockdown candles now stand along the front edge of the treehouse's terrace, a long loading bar you can read at the normal zoom

changes.title: Sea life sound
items: Lying on the beach you can hear the dolphins splashing off the east coast
Off the west coast, now and then, the kraken groans and the sea pours off its tentacles

changes.title: Later quests
items: Sleeping legends now dream of creatures from deeper in the forest, further along the party's path
Every finished quest's buff is the same strength, however far you went for it
